company.name: Asendia AI
company.shortDescription: Asendia AI develops an AI recruitment platform to automate candidate screening and interviewing processes.
company.description: Asendia AI develops a generative AI platform that automates HR tasks for recruitment. The platform helps businesses and recruitment firms enhance their processes. It utilizes an agentic-based framework to streamline various HR functions, improving efficiency and reducing time spent on recruitment activities. The focus is on providing tools that assist job seekers in preparing for interviews and helping businesses identify suitable candidates efficiently.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 48.54% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,014,118 to $6,714,485, a 1.34x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 93 (+25 over 90 days) and market heat at 84 (+6).
